name: github-desktop-plus
description: External enhancement tool for GitHub Desktop — built with Electrobun + Vue 3

scripts.start: vite build && bun run build:hooks && electrobun dev
scripts.build:hooks: bun build src/hooks/index.ts --outdir=build/hooks --target=node --format=cjs --external electron && bun build src/hooks/preload/index.ts --outfile=build/hooks/preload/index.js --target=node --format=cjs --external electron
scripts.build:canary: vite build && bun run build:hooks && electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:release: vite build && bun run build:hooks && electrobun build --env=release
